# Stakeholder Reply

## What happened

Describe the incident in plain language and retain the conclusion status.

## User impact

State who or what was affected, for how long, and any known boundaries.

## Confirmed or probable cause

Explain the cause without unsupported certainty or unnecessary implementation detail.

## Current status

State whether the issue is ongoing, mitigated, resolved, or still under investigation.

## Immediate action

Describe the approved short-term action and any safety condition.

## Permanent fix

Describe the planned long-term correction and ownership when known.

## Validation status

State completed and remaining validation. Do not call an untested fix complete.

## Required action from the recipient

State the exact action needed, or say that no action is required.
